page_title: JUV 3-1 UDI | Juventus v Udinese 29/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' Marco Di Bello is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' 3 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Maduka Okoye no chance!
90+6' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
90+5' It’s a PENALTY to Juventus after the VAR review!

90+3' Play continues despite the shouts by some Juventus players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Marco Di Bello interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
90+3' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
90+2' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Michele Di Gregorio (Juventus) picks up a yellow card.
90' Vakoun Issouf Bayo (Udinese) climbs high to connect with a perfect cross and produces a header that goes not far wide of the right post.
90' Udinese have a corner.
89' Massimo Brambilla has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) replacing Dusan Vlahovic.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Daniele Rugani (Juventus) replaces Filip Kostic.
82' A yellow card for a tackle by Lennon Miller (Udinese). Marco Di Bello doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
79' The game is interrupted. Sandi Lovric (Udinese) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
79' The ball spins to Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) on the edge of the box. He hits across the ball and sends it goalwards, but it goes just wide of the left post.
77' The resulting set piece from Juventus is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
77' Lois Openda goes off the pitch and Jonathan David (Juventus) comes on.
76' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play. Juventus are awarded a corner kick.
74' Kosta Runjaic has decided to substitute Arthur Atta and he is replaced by Lennon Miller (Udinese).
74' The game has come to an end for Kingsley Ehizibue. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Alessandro Zanoli (Udinese).
72' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
70' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

69' A snap shot by Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) from the edge of the area flies towards the roof of the net, but Maduka Okoye produces a good save to thwart him. The linesman points to the corner flag, Juventus are going to take it.
67' 2 - 1 Federico Gatti (Juventus) jumps for a cross and plants a perfect header inside the left post.
67' Juventus have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

66' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful volley was directed towards the top right corner, but Maduka Okoye was alert and made an astonishing save! Juventus will take a corner kick.
65' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post.
61' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Lois Openda (Juventus), whose effort would probably have ended inside the left post.
61' Weston McKennie (Juventus) sends a cross into the box, but Maduka Okoye comes off his line to gather the ball.
58' Kosta Runjaic decides to make a substitution. Nicolo Zaniolo will be replaced by Vakoun Issouf Bayo (Udinese).
58' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Sandi Lovric (Udinese) comes onto the pitch so that Jakub Piotrowski can be given a rest.
56' An attempted cross from Weston McKennie (Juventus) is cleared.
54' Filip Kostic (Juventus) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
53' Juventus take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
53' Filip Kostic (Juventus) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
51' Udinese quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
50' Saba Goglichidze (Udinese) latches on to a fine cross from the resulting corner and attempts to finish, but his shot flies over the bar.
49' Corner kick. Udinese will have an opportunity.

49' A great cross finds Saba Goglichidze (Udinese) in space and his bullet header towards the right side of the goal looks destined for the net, but Michele Di Gregorio brilliantly tips the ball round the post.
46' Referee Marco Di Bello blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Marco Di Bello lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
45+1' 1 - 1 Goal! Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a shot inside the left post. It's 1:1.
45+1' Adam Buksa (Udinese) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.

40' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom left corner is blocked by Maduka Okoye, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.

39' Filip Kostic (Juventus) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
38' Kosta Runjaic is forced to make a change. Keinan Davis (Udinese) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Adam Buksa.
37' Lois Openda (Juventus) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Maduka Okoye sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the top right corner.
34' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) outjumps his marker and heads the resulting corner high over the bar.
33' The ball goes out of play. Juventus are awarded a corner kick.
33' Lois Openda (Juventus) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
30' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) launches a cross from the corner, but Maduka Okoye is alert to thwart the effort.
30' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The referee signals a corner kick to Juventus.
30' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
29' Filip Kostic (Juventus) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
29' Filip Kostic (Juventus) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
22' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
19' A cross from the corner kick arrives at the feet of Hassane Kamara (Udinese), giving him an opportunity to shoot. He misses completely, way over the bar.
19' Udinese will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
19' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
16' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) has a goal ruled out for offside!
10' Lois Openda (Juventus) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the left of the target.
9' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
5' 1 - 0 Goal! Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Maduka Okoye into the bottom left corner.
5' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) is going to take the penalty!
3' Saba Goglichidze (Udinese) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
3' A clumsy foul by Saba Goglichidze (Udinese) and Marco Di Bello blows his whistle. It's a penalty to Juventus! Let's see who's going to take it.
3' Neat passing move from Juventus in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The match has just started.
Juventus will kick the game off.
Marco Di Bello got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
